== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Nundak The Archer]] ([[Melandru's Hope]])

== Related skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Extend Conditions}} ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* This skill extends any conditions you inflict as long as you are wielding a bow, including conditions from [[trap]]s, [[spell]]s, and [[Skill (skill type)|skills]] like [[Throw Dirt]]. 
*Can be used with [[Technobabble]] to keep a group of enemies dazed
* The burning caused by [[Blazing Finale]] is also increased, no matter who cast it on the ranger.
* Does not increase the duration of conditions spread using [[Pestilence]], however it does increase those transferred using [[Epidemic]] or [[Hypochondria]].
{{bug|This skill does not increase the amount of time a target is [[burning]] from [[Glyph of Immolation]] nor [[Mark of Rodgort]].}}

==Trivia==
*[[Archer's Signet]] and [[Favorable Winds]] are the only non-[[bow attack]] or [[preparation]] [[skill]]s that require a bow.
